text:
Iyad Khan: hey everyone :wave: I’m Iyad — starting today on ML Infra. Quick background: came from a small startup optimizing model serving. PST timezone. Fun fact: rescue corgi named Biscuit who’s very opinionated about keyboard placement. excited to be here!

Tanya (People Ops): welcome Iyad!! :tada: buddy is Alex G. — he’ll send a DM for the 1:1 and run you through the onboarding checklist. swag shipping email should be in your inbox.

Alex G.: hi Iyad, I’m your buddy — DM sent. For hardware/MDM please follow the onboarding guide (link in #help) or ping IT Support. We usually ship M1s to infra unless you asked for a different config.

Iyad Khan: thanks — i did request an M1 in the form. also can you confirm which repos i should get access to initially? console and infra repos mainly.

IT Support: @Iyad Khan jamf invite sent from jamf@redwood.com. If you don’t see it check spam and reply here. Shipping tracking: 1-800-TRACK — we’ll escalate if delayed.

Morgan L.: welcome! For Console access open a ticket in #help like: `team: ml-infra, resources: console-read+write, reason: onboarding`. @Jules will approve once Alex confirms your team membership.

Jules N.: I’ll approve the Console request after Alex confirms. Don’t forget to request VPN/dev LDAP if you’ll touch on-prem infra.

Iyad Khan: cool — i’ll paste my SSH pub key into the help ticket. side Q: is there a recommended dotfiles or editor config for infra folks?

Alex G.: most of the team uses VSCode + Remote-SSH. I’ll share my devcontainer and dotfiles in the DM. Also will walk you through local env tomorrow.

Infra Bot: New hire checklist: `hardware_received: false`, `mdm_enrolled: false`, `console_access: pending`. Follow-up scheduled in 24h.

Tanya (People Ops): welcome lunch tomorrow 12:30pm PT — remote folks get a $15 stipend. Calendar invite sent. Also 1pm intro with eng org.

Iyad Khan: heads up — Biscuit may add background noise to a call or two. preemptive apology :dog:

Morgan L.: perfect — we have #pets for corgi appreciation. Biscuit will be verified by the sticker test :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: 

Alex G.: added you to ml-infra channel and repos (read-only for now). I also updated the pager docs so you can skim.

IT Support: Jamf invite resent. If not visible in 30 minutes ping here and we’ll escalate.

Iyad Khan: got the jamf invite, enrolling now. thanks all :heart:

Alex G.: great, see you at the intro tomorrow :thumbsup: 

Jules N.: noted for Console permissions — will approve on receipt once Alex confirms.

Iyad Khan: last thing — where’s the eval harness for Redwood Optimize? wanting to drop quick prompt tests.

Morgan L.: put evals in `redwood/evals` repo and tag @research or @eng-ml. README has examples and a small CI harness.

Infra Bot: Reminder set (24h): follow up on MDM enrollment and hardware delivery.

Tanya (People Ops): super excited to have you Iyad. welcome again :tada:
